changes.title: Israeli efforts to seize more Palestinian land have reached a frenzied pitch
changes.summary: Israeli efforts to establish new Jewish settlements and seize Palestinian land have reached a frenzied pitch in the occupied West Bank, where Palestinian residents say they have been encircled and besieged by violent settlers.
